children: Acorn Energy’s OmniMetrix acquired Generator Solutions’ Gen-Tracker standby generator monitoring assets for $3.5 million, adding customers, dealer relationships, IP, technology, receivables and inventory. Payment terms include $1.0 million at closing, $450,000 on each of the first four anniversaries, and $700,000 on the fifth anniversary. To support the integration, OmniMetrix also entered a one-year lease for premises in Oakdale, Minnesota, at $108,000 annually, or $9,000 per month. The moves are expected to broaden OmniMetrix’s remote monitoring footprint and strengthen market reach.
